rest.source: US EPA Exposure Factors Handbook 2011, Ch. 6, Table 6-2 (sedentary/passive = baseline)

walk.source: US EPA EFH 2011 Ch. 6 Table 6-2, light intensity (children 6-<11: 2.3x; adults 21-<31: 2.9x)

errands.source: US EPA EFH 2011 Ch. 6 Table 6-2, light intensity (assumed for errands)

commute.source: US EPA EFH 2011 Ch. 6 Table 6-2; seated travel assumed sedentary-to-light

play.source: US EPA EFH 2011 Ch. 6 Table 6-2, moderate intensity (children 4.6x; adults 6.2x)

cycle.source: US EPA EFH 2011 Ch. 6 Table 6-2, moderate intensity; consistent with de Nazelle et al. 2012, Atmospheric Environment 59:151-159 (active commuters inhale 2-3x more volume than car commuters)

exercise.source: US EPA EFH 2011 Ch. 6 Table 6-2, moderate to high intensity (adults 21-<31)

indoor-windows-closed.source: Cyrys et al. 2004, J Expo Anal Environ Epidemiol 14(4) - PM2.5 I/O 0.63 with closed windows (Erfurt). Range is our assumption.

indoor-windows-open.source: Assumption. Chen & Zhao 2011, Atmospheric Environment 45(2):275-288 reviews I/O ratios and finds wide variation.

in-vehicle.source: NEEDS_SOURCE - assumption; in-cabin levels vary with windows, ventilation and vehicle
